scope: Initial editable FBC Builder intake allowlist, not a claim of subscription availability or organizational approval.

agenticPatterns.name: Let AI decide
agenticPatterns.description: Copilot proposes a fitting customer scenario and the simplest useful pattern from your description, industry and business units.

agenticPatterns.name: Single-Agent Tool Loop
agenticPatterns.description: One agent uses a bounded set of tools to handle a coherent business task.

agenticPatterns.name: Sequential / Pipeline
agenticPatterns.description: Dependent stages process a business case in a defined order.

agenticPatterns.name: Concurrent / Fan-Out-Fan-In
agenticPatterns.description: Independent evidence checks run in parallel, then combine into one result.

agenticPatterns.name: Routing / Triage
agenticPatterns.description: Classify a request and direct it to the right authorized workflow.

agenticPatterns.name: Handoff / Transfer of Control
agenticPatterns.description: Transfer an ongoing case and its context to another responsible agent or person.

agenticPatterns.name: Moderated Group Chat
agenticPatterns.description: A moderator guides multiple perspectives toward a bounded case review.

agenticPatterns.name: Magentic Dynamic Collaboration
agenticPatterns.description: A manager adjusts specialist participation as an open-ended investigation develops.

agenticPatterns.name: Supervisor / Hierarchical Delegation
agenticPatterns.description: A supervisor coordinates known specialists and owns the final response.

agenticPatterns.name: Orchestrator-Workers
agenticPatterns.description: An orchestrator divides variable-sized work into bounded assignments and reconciles the results.

agenticPatterns.name: Planner-Executor
agenticPatterns.description: Create an inspectable plan before executing its authorized steps.

agenticPatterns.name: Deterministic Loop
agenticPatterns.description: Repeat a bounded process until a code-defined completion condition is met.

agenticPatterns.name: Evaluator-Optimizer / Reflection
agenticPatterns.description: Evaluate a draft against a clear rubric and revise it within a fixed budget.

agenticPatterns.name: Mixture of Agents
agenticPatterns.description: Generate diverse candidates and synthesize their evidence into a stronger answer.

agenticPatterns.name: Event-Driven / Reactive Agents
agenticPatterns.description: An authorized business event triggers a bounded workflow with replay and failure handling.

agenticPatterns.name: Blackboard / Shared Workspace
agenticPatterns.description: Contributors coordinate through a persistent, access-controlled case workspace.

agenticPatterns.name: Swarm / Peer-to-Peer
agenticPatterns.description: Authorized peers coordinate work without one fixed central decision-maker.

agenticPatterns.name: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)
agenticPatterns.description: A recorded human decision gates a consequential action within the business workflow.

agenticPatterns.name: Adaptive Hybrid / Composite Orchestration
agenticPatterns.description: Use an explicit policy to combine a small set of patterns for different work or risk classes.

services.name: Azure Cosmos DB
services.description: Operational data for grounded agent workflows

services.name: Azure API Management
services.description: Governed access to agent tools and APIs
